title: Litany
summary: LIT'ANY, noun [Gr. supplication, to pray.] A solemn form of supplication, used in public worship. Supplications for the appeasing of God's wrath, were by the Greek church termed litanies, by the Latin

inlines.v: LIT'ANY, noun [Gr. supplication, to pray.] A solemn form of supplication, used in public worship. Supplications for the appeasing of God's wrath, were by the Greek church termed litanies, by the Latin, rogations.
